items.stem: Which TWO checks matter when Gemini extracts action items from a thread? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Confirm each task is attributed to the correct owner
options.rationale: Correct: misattribution is a common extraction error.

options.text: Verify dates and commitments against the original messages
options.rationale: Correct: extracted details must be checked against the source.

options.text: Assume every extracted task is final
options.rationale: Extraction can be wrong and needs review.

options.text: Send the list before reading it
options.rationale: Unreviewed output should not be sent.

items.explanation: Correct: confirming owners and verifying details against the source are both needed.
